task: After a legal frontier decision, rank equal-budget candidate action prefixes by the number of distinct new, unreported target instances that enter a legal report viewpoint along that prefix.
data: 12 HSSD houses for fitting, four prior development houses for calibration, four previously unused houses for the only independent V7 check. All natural runs have an empty report history. No HM3D or Blender results select this model.
cases: Retain all supplied fixed official target-category rows, including all-zero and all-tie rows; group by true start, then by house. Multiple held views repeat a physical start, not independent starts. Candidate origins cycle uniformly in the absence of a real MOST VLM choice. Compare alternative prefixes of equal 4/12/24-command budget that differ at at least one command. An override requires a strict 0.01 probability-score improvement.
arm: Frozen V5/V6 regional forecasts plus a trainable small visual prediction residual and a goal-conditioned reportability readout. Full views use the V5 predictor, sparse 1/2/3 contiguous real headings use V6. Equal prior across the four view conditions. No report memory is synthesized.
training: Seed 37, AdamW 0.001 with weight decay 0.01, 12 epochs maximum, batches of 12 (start,horizon) groups. Apply equal-weight mean of a uniform batch and a branch-informative oversample during training only. Loss weights: 1.0 signed pair rank, 0.35 balanced BCE for at least one new instance, 0.3 short-horizon JEPA regional cosine and 0.15 same-start relative future error. Batch BCE uses a training-set positive-class weight capped at 15. Epoch candidates 3,6,9,12. Fusion alpha candidates 0.5/1.0; no parameter selected on the four independent houses.
labels: The primary target gain_newly_eligible counts distinct targets newly within the allowed viewpoint radius after moving. All logs start without prior reports. A previously seen but still unreported instance remains a valid target. gain additionally excludes previously clearly visible instances and is a separate strict diagnostic. Initial report opportunities are counted separately. Ten derived target classes are wall art, picture frame, mirror, clock, door, lamp, cabinet, shelf, basket, stool. Color and landscape content have no label. Derived tasks use independently rendered geometric viewpoints, not official Habitat object labels.
selection: Jointly fit the available curated cases for the fixed six official and ten derived target classes. Among epoch/alpha candidates maximize official-only calibration house-equal gated new-instance gain, including all zero rows. Ties prefer smaller alpha then earlier epoch. Compare against the same V6 forecasts and frozen goal scores for both full and partial coverage. The single independent admission test uses official labels only; report the identically scored attributes separately.
release_gate: On the independent four-house panel, (1) at least one branch-informative physical start in each of at least two houses, (2) house-equal absolute gain over keeping the reference greater than zero, (3) strictly greater gain than V6, the V7 observed-directions-only counterfactual, and wrong-target V7, all on identical rows, and (4) at least two houses with a strictly positive paired difference from V6. A failed gate precludes a claim about improvement; no retuning on holdout.
scope: Goal-conditioned frontier ranking only. The prediction does not establish REPORT, instance matching, action execution, or quota completion. For HSSD the environment-defined legal viewpoint is a surrogate and additionally uses the dataset's independent visibility/novelty labels.
